owner_activation_scope: The controlled execution route is the sole-owner CLI. Only that owner enforces the exact root activation and helper prerequisite. The pure worker CLI can technically be called directly; controlled root ownership, rather than a worker-level activation check, provides the declared prerequisite. No claim that direct worker invocation is impossible.
buffer_scope: 65536 characters is the JSON iterencode coalescing threshold, not a hard emitted-byte or single-token cap. A single encoded string token may be larger, UTF-8 byte length can exceed character length. The decoder separately fails unknown for pending fragments above2097152 bytes. Full512MiB kernel+owner gate remains authoritative.
execution_owner: Root owns and will launch both pure helpers and any later actual full evaluation replay. Subagent has executed only source preparation/AST and exact-pin verification; no helper, trace decoder, graph replay, search, training or native execution.
clock_scope: These are separately disclosed preparation/verification measurements, excluding process startup/final receipt write and uninstrumented earlier reading/design; not complete research-time totals.
